title: Research sprint goal: Agent deduplication and structured coordination are tested
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.

gates.question: Which article holds the facts on a headless -p run's session id variable, /skill-name prompts and project hooks with --settings, given the notes name the coordination articles?

notes: Planner's open questions for the kb (answer with kb_pack first, then the claude-code-docs server): (1) does a headless claude -p session give its Bash tool its own session id in an environment variable, so coord.py can default the holder to it when KB_COORD_HOLDER is unset; (2) do project skills invoked as the first line of a -p prompt (/kb-research ...) and project hooks run in claude -p with --settings and --strict-mcp-config, as the SP-3pvz2noj transcripts show; (3) what published multi-agent work (Anthropic's multi-agent research system, MCP or agent framework docs) says about measuring duplicated work between parallel agents and claim or lease coordination. Facts go to the kb's existing agent-coordination articles (EP-ylklxolb's domain), not to _self.
